read.availability: Adoptable proposals provide the statement, packs, and approve_with command; non-adoptable proposals provide a problem.

write.authentication: Partner's own same-origin session with x-carr-csrf; no machine identity.
write.recovery: version_conflict requires a fresh read and another review. Unknown outcomes retain and replay the exact session-bound request under Check outcome.
write.confirmation: Require every receipt field. All UUIDs use the canonical lowercase 36-character form; generation is a positive safe integer. Retirement-only has null rule_id, card_id, load_layer and approval, empty packs and nonempty retired_rule_ids. Replacements use pack delivery with null card_id and nonempty packs, or control delivery with nonempty card_id and empty packs; approval is complete, matches rule_id, and records active authority_enforced approval with human_authority_runtime installed and no pending controls. Retirement IDs and packs are sorted and unique. The write envelope may add replayed:true. No digest or hash fields are returned by this pinned receipt; approval_receipt_id is a UUID. Missing, mistyped or unrecognized fields leave the outcome unknown.
